title: Asha cancels during the notice period
story: ShopBot pays INR 1,250 and the bank sends Asha the advance notice before the card is charged. During the notice period she cancels ShopBot's permission. When the notice period ends, the Guard checks again and stops the charge: MANDATE_REVOKED, no money taken.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Reorder my usual milk and bread, please.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Your usual basket at FreshMart comes to INR 1,250. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Allowed. Paying FreshMart now; your bank will send the advance notice first.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Actually, cancel ShopBot's permission to pay for me.

steps.label: Skip to the end of the notice period

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The payment is waiting out the notice period.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Checking whether the payment went through.

what_to_notice: The card is charged only after the notice period, and just before charging the Guard checks the permission again. Asha withdrew it, so the payment failed with MANDATE_REVOKED and no money moved.
